items.q: Facts collected in rows and columns are called…
Putting rows in order from biggest to smallest is…
You want to know which month had the most rain. What do you do first?
items.why: The question is about rain amounts, so the rain column is the one to sort by.

items.q: To find the most common pet in the class, you should…
choices: group the rows by pet and count
items.why: Most common means the biggest group. Grouping by pet and counting each group shows it.

items.q: A chart supports a claim when…
items.why: A claim is only fair when the data on the screen really shows it, not when it just sounds good.

items.q: A guess about what comes next, based on data, is a…
The plant grew 2 cm each day for 5 days. On day 6 it will most likely be…
items.why: The pattern adds 2 cm every day, so the best guess for day 6 is day 5 plus 2 cm more.

items.q: The chart shows only 2 days of plant growth. Can we predict day 10?
choices: not yet, we need more days
items.why: Two days is too little data to trust a pattern. More days make the prediction safer.

items.q: The chart shows Tuesday is the tallest bar. Which claim is supported?
choices: most lunches were sold on Tuesday
items.why: The tallest bar is Tuesday's, and the chart counts lunches, so Tuesday sold the most lunches.

items.q: Asking many people the same question and counting the answers is a…
Which chart answers "which fruit is most popular?" fastest?
choices: a list of every kid's name
a bar chart with one bar per fruit
items.why: One bar per fruit makes the tallest bar easy to spot: that fruit is the most popular.

items.q: 12 kids said dog, 3 said cat. Which claim is fair?
choices: everyone in the world prefers dogs
dogs are the favorite pet in our class
items.why: The claim stays inside what the data covers: this class. It does not speak for the whole world.

items.q: Why ask another pair whether your claim is fair?
choices: so they can copy your work
they may see something your pair missed
items.why: Fresh eyes catch slips and unfair jumps that the pair who made the claim may miss.
